name: Wall Surface Projection & Texture Mapping
definition: Projects a 3D block face to 2D screen coordinates, handles X/Y clipping, calculates UV mapping with perspective-correct interpolation, applies per-face shading, and draws pixels.
summary: Wall Surface Projection & Texture Mapping renders opaque voxel data by projecting visible block faces onto the screen, distinguishing itself from standard texture slicing by treating surfaces as discrete geometric primitives rather than compositing semi-transparent slices.
